plainTranslation: Confidence and opportunity flow. The easiest stretch to expand. Use it before it passes; ease breeds laziness.
policy: Transit-to-natal entries are ordered: transiting planet to natal point. Do not apply same-moment aspect exclusions. Interpret as an active pressure or opening, not a guaranteed event.
